title: AI Resume Analyzer
description: A Python app that reviews resumes, extracts skills, and returns role-fit insights with AI-assisted scoring.
details: AI Resume Analyzer parses resume content, highlights missing keywords, and gives a practical match score for target roles. It is designed for fast screening workflows where candidates need clear, actionable feedback instead of vague summaries.

title: Data Scraping Dashboard
description: A scraping and reporting workflow that turns public web data into structured tables and simple dashboards.
details: This project combines Python scraping scripts with scheduled cleanup and export logic. It is built for repeatable market research, lead enrichment, and listing-monitoring tasks where clean data matters more than raw volume.

title: CRM Flow Setup
description: A Salesforce admin setup with guided lead routing, field structure, and automated task creation.
details: CRM Flow Setup focuses on making sales operations easier to follow. It includes clean object fields, simple page layouts, routing logic, and flow-driven reminders so teams can move leads forward without manual tracking.

title: Sales Dashboard Pack
description: A reporting package for pipeline visibility, activity tracking, and sales performance reviews.
details: Sales Dashboard Pack organizes CRM metrics into useful dashboards for owners, managers, and sales users. The project emphasizes practical visibility: pipeline stages, conversion trends, activity follow-ups, and missed opportunities.

title: Portfolio Platform
description: A premium responsive portfolio built with reusable sections, smooth motion, and strong content hierarchy.
details: Portfolio Platform is built as a polished personal brand system with focused sections, fast-loading UI, motion accents, and scalable content patterns for services, projects, and contact workflows.

title: Service Booking UI
description: A modern booking interface for service businesses with clear steps, responsive layouts, and clean forms.
details: Service Booking UI turns a service funnel into a simple guided experience. It includes service cards, availability states, form validation patterns, and conversion-focused layouts designed for repeat use.

title: AI Workflow Automation
description: A smart automation layer for classifying requests, triggering follow-ups, and reducing repetitive work.
details: AI Workflow Automation connects business tools into reliable operational flows. It can classify messages, route work, notify the right people, and keep customer data organized without manual copy-paste.

title: Support Chatbot System
description: An AI-assisted chatbot flow for capturing leads, answering FAQs, and escalating complex requests.
details: Support Chatbot System provides a structured conversational layer for service businesses. It handles common questions, collects useful lead details, and passes qualified conversations into follow-up workflows.
